info.name: Dokiments
info.description: Local API testing collection for the Firestore-backed routes built in Phase 0/1 (see docs/api-templates-documents.md). Auth is a session cookie, not a bearer token — Postman's built-in cookie jar handles it automatically once you run "Sign in", so no manual header wiring is needed between requests in this collection.

request.description: Establishes the session cookie (dokiments-session) that every other request in this collection relies on. Response body is { user: AuthUser } only — tokens never leave the server. Check the collection's Cookies panel for localhost after sending this to confirm the cookie was set. If DEV_AUTH_BYPASS=true is set in .env.local, any email/password works and you'll get a fake session with role: "special" — useful for testing everything except the seed script, which needs a real superadmin account.

Returns { user: AuthUser } if the session cookie is valid, or 401 null otherwise. Useful to confirm you're actually signed in before testing a protected route, and to check which role/tier the current session has.

Destroys the session cookie. Run this between test scenarios to reset to a signed-out state, then use "Unauthorised (401) check" under each resource folder to confirm routes reject the request correctly.
GET /api/templates — full active catalog. Session required (401 without one). See docs/api-templates-documents.md for the response shape ({ templates: MarketplaceTemplate[] }).

item.name: List catalog filtered by style + tier

request.description: Same route with optional query filters. Try an invalid value (e.g. styleId=nonsense) to confirm the Zod query validation returns 400, not a silent empty result.
GET /api/templates/:id. Try a nonexistent ID (e.g. does-not-exist) to confirm you get 404 { error: "Template not found." }, not a 500.

Run this AFTER "Sign out" (or in a fresh incognito-style environment with no prior sign-in) to confirm the route actually rejects an unauthenticated Postman request with 401 { error: "Unauthorised." } — this is the concrete scenario withSession was built to close.
GET /api/saved-templates — the signed-in user's saved-template list (empty array for a brand-new user). Session required.

POST /api/saved-templates. Current implementation overwrites the whole saved list with `items` (whole-array model, unchanged from before the Phase 0/1 relocation — Phase 2 migrates this to a per-template subcollection). Run "List saved templates" afterwards to confirm the write landed.
Run AFTER "Sign out" to confirm this route also 401s without a session, same as the templates catalog check.
